our_interpretation: 'The end of the year' means December 31, 2026.

The forecast is the spending threshold: cumulative hyperscaler capex plus equity investments in AI labs exceeding $1.5 trillion by year-end. Read plainly, this counts AI-era capex (about 2023 onward) by the large cloud and platform companies (Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, and plausibly Oracle), plus their stakes in OpenAI, Anthropic and similar labs.

The revenue clause describes the state when he wrote. It is checked as of the post date: had hyperscalers disclosed separate LLM revenue in their financial reports? It is not treated as a forecast that disclosure would never come before year-end.
Capex is counted as reported, not split into LLM and non-LLM shares, since the companies do not report such a split.
criteria.support_condition: Reported figures through December 31, 2026 show cumulative hyperscaler capex plus AI-lab equity investments above $1.5 trillion, and the companies had not separately disclosed realized LLM revenue as of the post.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Cumulative capex plus AI equity investments through 2026 fall short of $1.5 trillion, or hyperscalers were already disclosing realized LLM revenue in their reports when he wrote.
